raw.details:
SHAKTI Hackathon

A Durga Puja Special

This Pujo, don’t just celebrate the power. Build with it.

Durga Puja is all about Shakti, creativity, energy, and coming together. This festive season, BUBBLESORT brings that spirit into technology with SHAKTI Hackathon, a student-focused challenge to turn real-world problems into meaningful tech solutions.

Eligibility and Teams

  • Open to students from computer-related or technology-oriented academic backgrounds

  • Students in any year of study, as well as passed-out or graduated students, may participate

  • Teams may have 1 to 3 members

  • Each participant may join only one team

  • Team changes after registration require organizer approval

Hackathon Themes

AI-Agentic Solutions
Build AI-powered systems that automate tasks, assist users, manage workflows, or solve real-world problems.

Women’s Safety / Blockchain
Build technology solutions focused on women’s safety and security. Blockchain-based approaches are welcome where relevant.

Natural Disaster Safety
Create solutions for disaster preparedness, early warning, emergency response, public safety, or disaster management.

Obesity Control and Medical Fitness
Build technology solutions focused on obesity prevention and management, including fitness tracking, health monitoring, progress tracking, and lifestyle management.

Heritage and Culture
Create digital solutions to preserve, explore, promote, or experience cultural heritage.

AR/VR is optional.

Registration

  • Registration is free

  • Registration is through the official Unstop event page

  • 150+ participants and growing

Timeline and Submissions

Round 1: Idea Submission

27 September 2026, 10:00 AM IST – 21 October 2026, 12:00 PM IST

Submit your project idea as a PPT or PPTX. Your presentation should explain:

Problem → Proposed Solution → Technology → Implementation Approach → Expected Impact

Only submissions received within the round’s timeline will be considered for the final round.

Round 2: Final Video Presentation

23 October 2026, 12:00 AM IST – 25 October 2026, 12:01 AM IST

Finalist teams must submit a video presentation of their completed project. The video should cover:

  • The problem and proposed solution

  • Technology used and implementation

  • Key features and impact

Teams should also demonstrate their working project and explain how it functions. The submitted video will be considered for final evaluation.

Project Rules

  • Projects must align with one of the official hackathon themes

  • Web applications, mobile applications, AI/ML solutions, software platforms, and working prototypes are allowed

  • AI tools may be used for coding, research, debugging, documentation, brainstorming, and development

  • APIs, open-source libraries, frameworks, datasets, and other public resources are allowed

  • Existing or ongoing projects are allowed, but teams must clearly disclose what was built before SHAKTI and what was newly developed or improved for the hackathon

  • Participants must be able to explain and understand their submissions

  • Plagiarism, fraudulent submissions, impersonation, or misrepresentation may lead to disqualification

Evaluation

The hackathon is evaluated out of 30 marks:

  • PPT / Idea Presentation: 15 marks

  • Final Project / Video Presentation: 15 marks

Projects may be assessed on:

  • Problem understanding

  • Solution quality

  • Technical implementation

  • Functionality

  • Creativity and approach

  • Presentation

Teams with female participants will receive extra points during evaluation as part of the Shakti initiative.

Prizes

The top three winning teams will receive:

  • 1st place: Swags worth ₹1,000

  • 2nd place: Swags worth ₹500

  • 3rd place: Swags worth ₹300

Top-performing teams will also receive recognition from BUBBLESORT.

Internship Opportunity

A chance to take your work beyond the hackathon

The Top 10 participants or teams may be considered for internship opportunities with BUBBLESORT.

Selected interns may receive a performance-based stipend ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹8,000. The stipend will depend on performance and the applicable internship terms.

Internship opportunities are subject to selection and availability. Participation in SHAKTI Hackathon does not guarantee an internship.

Project Ownership

If your team uses an existing or ongoing project, clearly explain what was developed before the hackathon and what was newly built or improved for SHAKTI.

Pujo Mode: Activated

The pandals will be glowing.
The dhak will be playing.
The group chats will be chaotic.

Somewhere between “Pujo ashche!” and “bro, where is the PPT?”, you might build something awesome.

Come with an idea. Come with your squad. Come with your laptop.

PUJO. CODE. CREATE.

27 SEP → 21 OCT | Round 1: Idea Submission
23 OCT → 25 OCT | Round 2: Final Video Presentation

FREE | Teams of 1–3 | 150+ participants and growing

Choose a problem. Build a solution. Show your Shakti.
